name: 60 — the-M user door with no rule
description:
Same kind of door (the-M account login) but with no role rule.
Any valid account of this tenant may enter, so the test user does.
What we check: with no rule, the login alone is enough.
Setup: python3.12 test-runner/scripts/setup_ep_role_scenario.py (creates the doors; --reset undoes). Login used: payops-test, whose the-M membership role is 'admin'.
